title: Current large language models deserve a low credence of consciousness

statements.text: Six candidate requirements count against current language models: biology, sensory grounding, self models, recurrent processing, a global workspace and unified agency. With a credence of at least a third in each, and a current model lacking all six, the chance it is conscious comes to somewhere under ten percent. The strongest of these are recurrent processing, global workspace and unified agency.

sources.quote: Perhaps the strongest objections are those from recurrent processing, global workspace, and unified agency
it’s reasonable to have a low credence that current paradigmatic LLMs such as the GPT systems are conscious
